principles: Use existing F-host canonical runner only; never create a second runner.
Treat application/xml reader failures, DNS failures and download-client failures as transport limitations, not NO_DATA.
Do not guess WCS CoverageId from WMS layer names or dataset titles.
WMS preview imagery is non-queryable and cannot produce numeric elevation.
Use HMLR native EPSG:27700 polygon geometry for raster masks; retain general-boundary legal guard.
Require actual OS Downloads JSON/archive evidence before accepting Terrain50 files.

sequence.action: Run existing guarded F-host recovery script and verify all four receipts.
Verify exactly one persistent canonical daemon plus fresh heartbeat and exact task/attempt/continuation claim.
Fetch EA DTM1m WCS 2.0.1 GetCapabilities XML with an XML-capable client and record exact CoverageId, supported formats, CRS and operation endpoints.
Issue DescribeCoverage for the observed CoverageId; record grid axis labels, native CRS, bounding envelope and supported coverage format.
Resolve National LIDAR and Time Stamped survey lineage for TQ3595, TQ5090 and TQ2570; record survey dates, resolution, transform and geoid from observed records.
Request bounded GetCoverage subsets for native HMLR EPSG:27700 polygon envelopes; retain only observed GeoTIFF/raw coverage pixels.
Mask pixels by native polygons, exclude -3.4028235e+38 NoData and compute min/q1/median/q3/max only from valid observed pixels.
Call current OS OpenData Terrain50 product/details/download endpoints with area=TQ; require actual JSON and archive bytes.
Verify real TQ39/TQ59/TQ27 grid and Metadata_<tile>.xml members, datum/flying-date provenance and 50m pixel-centre indexing.
Run three EA primary versus Terrain50 secondary numeric crosschecks without promoting Terrain50 to primary accuracy.
Verify port 8012 HTTP readback and row-by-row web rendering.
Human review before any final/canonical promotion.
